completeness: Inventory, not a claim. CaltechDATA: every record surfaced by the listed queries was opened; the MEAD mirror was enumerated by title class (172 XRD/SSRL analysis records, 574 electrochemistry analysis records, 482 XRF analysis records, 14 plate bundles with XRD+eche) and each zip's .ana was range-read, so plate-level counts are exact for records whose titles carry those phrases. Not covered: MEAD raw-measurement records without analyses (about 20k), the MPS SQL dump (4.5 GB, not downloaded), per-run eche .rcp conditions for non-bundle plates (pH/LED unread), papers not retrievable (Matter 2020 Cu-V-X, J Mater Chem A 2020 29-photoanode survey 10.1039/c9ta13829c, Chem Commun 2019 Mn photoanodes, PNAS 2017 SI). PNAS 2017 main text read in full (PMC HTML); J Phys Energy 2022 and npj Comput Mater 2022 read in full. Zenodo, figshare, MDF, Europe PMC, GitHub searched with the listed queries; no non-JCAP library with per-point XRD + PEC was found. Caveats a loader must respect: MEAD merits are photocurrents (I.A_photo) under heterogeneous electrolytes/LEDs, not EQE; most MEAD X-V and Mn-X plates hold 11-37 XRD points on a single line, ternary SSRL plates hold 149-849; XRD, PEC and XRF sample grids differ and must be joined by platemap position/composition.
